description.value:
You gain proficiency with the Technology skill and with simple blasters. When a force power you cast calls for a melee weapon attack, you can substitute a ranged weapon attack instead, provided you're wielding a blaster you're proficient with.

You've also learned to bend powers that normally can't affect droids or constructs so that they can. Doing so costs one use of this feature per additional target beyond the first that you want it to affect. You can use this feature twice, gaining an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, with all uses restored on a long rest.
